<thought>Using the retrieved DBE formula: DBE = (2C + 2 + N - H - X)/2. For C7H13O6, C=7, H=13, N=0, X=0. DBE = (2*7 + 2 - 13)/2 = (14 + 2 - 13)/2 = 3/2 = 1.5, which rounds to the nearest whole number for typical organic molecules, giving a DBE of 1.</thought>
<final_answer>1</final_answer>
